purpose.zh: 练大腿向内转的力量和控制，让髋更灵活
purpose.en: Build strength and control turning your thigh inward for more mobile hips.

text.zh: 坐直，后腿膝盖贴地，把小腿和脚抬起
text.en: Sit tall, keep your back knee down, and lift that shin and foot

text.zh: 前腿小腿横在身前，双手放在膝盖上。
text.en: Keep your front shin across your body and your hands on your knees.

text.zh: 顶上停一下，再慢慢放下。
text.en: Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

commonErrors.zh: 身体往后仰或歪向一边来抬脚
commonErrors.en: Leaning back or sideways to lift the foot.
Letting the back knee come off the floor.

cautions.zh: 髋或膝不舒服时抬低一点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your hip or knee feels uncomfortable, lift lower, and stop if it still hurts.

changes: purpose 去掉「髋内旋」改口语；补常见错误「后腿膝盖离地」
口令按 0.7 s 缩短（抬小腿/放下来）
用户已定：改名、计时/计次、每侧/起始侧、计数单位按最终口径处理，相关待定项清除
最终口径：按真实做法定（2026-11-01）
